description:
We’re a Toronto-based team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026! 🚀

Our team brings experience in software engineering, AI/ML, cloud computing, and geospatial data analysis. 

We're looking for passionate teammates with skills in Python, GIS, Earth science, satellite data, data visualization, UI/UX, and full-stack development.

Join us to build something innovative, scientifically meaningful, and impactful, with the goal of competing for NASA Space Apps awards!
